paragraphs.text: Eye is a creature type used for cards that depict magical sentient beings that usually appear as different forms of large, floating, single eyes or creatures where a large singular eye comprises the majority of their body.
Similar creature types include the Beholder , a Dungeons & Dragons monster with many eyes, and Homunculus , who on many planes have a single eye that takes up a large portion of their body mass.
This article is only about the creature type; there are many artifacts, enchantments, and lands with "eye" in their names that aren't Eyes .

Eyes appear primarily black aligned, though several appear in blue . The only eyes that aren't black or blue are Kharis & The Beholder , which is white-green , and Atraxi Warden , which is mono- white .
The first card printed with the type was Evil Eye of Urborg in Time Spiral .

The Eye creature type also appears on the silver-bordered Spy Eye in Unstable and Heroes of the Realm celebration card Kharis & The Beholder . However, Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms introduced the creature type Beholder to represent beholders instead.

Another Eye was printed in Strixhaven: School of Mages with Eyetwitch . Eyes would cameo in the sets Innistrad: Crimson Vow ( Revealing Eye ), Doctor Who ( Atraxi Warden ), Murders at Karlov Manor Commander ( Eye of Duskmantle ), Duskmourn: House of Horror ( Abhorrent Oculus and Creeping Peeper ), and Final Fantasy ( Ahriman ).
Other creatures that conceivably could have been Eyes are Unblinking Bleb and Wandering Eye . However, they are both Illusions instead.

Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore from Legends used to be subtype Evil Eye until it became became a Horror in Sixth Edition . When Evil Eye of Urborg was printed in Time Spiral , Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore was errataed to the Eye type to interact with it.
The Eyetwitch of Arcavios is a species of Eye Bat that is seen as the perfect ingredient for ocolumancers . They appear to be a bat with a singular, large eye.

Dominaria is home to several species of "Evil Eyes" and was the first type to be introduced. The Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore are large floating eyes that exist on the plane. The Urborg swamp was home to a type of Evil Eye of Urborg during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria that appeared as an eyeball on a floating mass of flesh. Aznaph once saw one and told Edahlis they should have stayed in Yavimaya .

Duskmourn is home to a few species of eye. The first is the Abhorrent Oculus , which is a massive flying eyeball with tentacles coming out of the back of it. The central pupil is surrounded by finger-like tentacles. Another is the Creeping Peeper, which is a spider-like creature with a central golden eye. They act as eyes for Valgavoth .

Innistrad features a type of eye horror known as the Revealing Eye that hides itself behind Concealing Curtains and appears as a large non-flying eye with numerous smaller eyes on it and octopus-like tentacles.
The Eye of Duskmantle was a type of bat-like creature with a large central eye that inhabited Duskmantle .
The Un-iverse is home to a type of eye spy which is an eye affixed to a flying metal attachment.

In Doctor Who , the Atraxi are a species of sapient alien eyes. They appear as large eyes about double the size of a human. They can attach themselves to crystalline, snowflake-like spacecraft to move through space. They were the first Eye associated with white mana.
In Final Fantasy , the Ahriman are an eye horror that has a large central eye, bat-like wings, and a round yellow body. They are a recurring enemy in the series.
